data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €888
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterstadt-Nord issued the income tax and solidarity surcharge assessment for 2025 on 27 April 2026. It results in a refund of €888.00.
data.explanation: The tax office has set your 2025 income tax at €8,214.00. Because more wage tax (Lohnsteuer) was withheld (€9,102.00), you get €888.00 back, paid to the account stated in the letter. The home office costs were only accepted as the flat rate (Homeoffice-Pauschale). If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the tax office; the app shows the deadline. Keep the notice safe. Consider a tax adviser if unsure.
data.tax_note: Income tax assessment for 2025; keep as proof of assessed income and refund.
